question: A train, 822 m long, is running at a speed of 67m/s. If it takes 133 seconds to cross a tunnel, then find the length of the tunnel.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Crossing tunnel ⇒ Distance = train length + tunnel length

Total distance = speed × time = 67 × 133 = 8911 m

Tunnel length = 8911 − 822

= 8089 m

**∴ Answer = 8089 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of train = 822 m

Speed = 67 m/s

Time = 133 sec

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = Train length + Tunnel length

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 67 × 133

⇒ = 8911 m

⇒ Total distance = Train length + Tunnel length

⇒ 8911 = 822 + Tunnel length

⇒ Tunnel length = 8911 − 822

⇒ = 8089 m

**∴ The correct answer is 8089 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Train Crossing Tunnel

Distance covered = Length of train + Length of tunnel.

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Unit Consistency

Always keep units consistent (m/s with meters, seconds).

Train Problems Shortcut

Total distance = speed × time, then subtract known length to find unknown.
